items.title: fix(llama-cpp): managed setup crashes and loops on macOS below 13.3 (…
items.summary: fix(llama-cpp): managed setup crashes and loops on macOS below 13.3 (#163358) * fix(llama-cpp): explain the macOS 13.3 floor instead of a dyld crash and retry loop The pinned b10809 macOS archives (x64 and arm64) are built with minos 13.3, and libggml-blas imports Accelerate's `_cblas_sgemm$NEWLAPACK$ILP64`, which macOS 12 does not export. On those hosts guided and embedding-only setup downloaded the build, failed with a raw `dyld: Symbol not found`, and told the user to retry, which can never succeed. Read the product version with sw_vers before reusing or downloading a macOS build and refuse below 13.3 with the route that works: build llama-server for that Mac and point models.providers.llama-cpp .localService.command at it, or use a remote provider. An unreadable version keeps the existing launch check as the guard. Host refusals, including the existing Linux glibc and musl checks, now throw UnsupportedLlamaServerHostError, and guided setup drops its "run doctor, then retry" advice for them. Fixes #128879 * test(llama-cpp): keep the install cancellation test host-independent On macOS hosts the default asset is a Darwin build, so the new sw_vers probe ran through the test's deferred execFile mock and doubled the call count. Answer sw_vers immediately, hold only the server version probe, and count server probes by command. * fix(llama-cpp): keep reusing a validating server on older macOS The macOS floor ran before the reuse branch, so guided setup on macOS 12 refused a self-built llama-server already in the managed install path even though it passes the pinned-build validation. Reuse any build that validates; on macOS below 13.3 turn a failed validation into the host-limit error with the launch failure as its cause, and gate only fresh downloads up front. * fix(llama-cpp): refuse unsupported hosts before any download Managed setup previously downloaded the embedding model (and, in chat mode, the chat GGUF) before calling into ensureLlamaServerInstalled, where the macOS 13.3 and Linux glibc checks live. On unsupported hosts the eventual refusal was correct, but hundreds of megabytes were already fetched for a dead-end install. Call ensureLlamaServerInstalled at the top of runLlamaCppSetup's try block instead, before any ensureLlamaCppModel call. Its validate-and- reuse branch (`installLlamaServer` returns an installed+validating server on any macOS version before asserting the OS floor) is preserved, so an older Mac with a self-built binary at the pinned release still reaches guided setup success — the earlier attempt that bypassed reuse via an unconditional host assertion is dropped. The nested call from prepareManagedLlamaServer later hits installationPromises as a cheap no-op. Tested on macOS 12.7.6 iMac11,2 (Core i3-540, no AVX): embedding-only setup refuses with the host-support message immediately when no installed server exists, with no GGUF download attempt and no dyld crash. The validating-server reuse path through guided setup is covered by a new regression test. * test(llama-cpp): exercise unreadable macOS version handling Reach the version probe from a failing installed server, preserve the launch error, fix setup test formatting, and clarify later runtime revalidation. No executable production behavior changes. Co-authored-by: VACInc --------- Co-authored-by: xXG0DLessXx Co-authored-by: NovaUnboundAi Co-authored-by: roboclaw-bot Co-authored-by: VACInc

items.title: 日經新聞員工M365帳號遭到入侵，被用於發布約9,000封釣魚信
items.summary: 日本大型媒體日本經濟新聞社（日經新聞）於10月4日，公布兩起涉及員工雲端服務帳號遭竊的資安事故。其中一起是員工的Microsoft 365帳號遭到攻擊，被用於發送約9,000封欺騙性的電子郵件。本地事故可能曝露收件人姓名、電子郵件地址，以及部分電子郵件內容，日經新聞已更改被盜帳號的密碼，向當地資料保護機關通報，並著手調查資料外洩影響範圍與人數。日經透露這件事故出現在9月30日，攻擊者濫用此M365帳號發送帶有連結的釣魚信，試圖將收信人導向惡意網站，目標涵蓋先前曾與該公司員工接觸過的人士。

items.title: JetBrains縮減KMP的Swift開發工具支援，Swift程式碼改由Xcode等工具處理
items.summary: JetBrains宣布，從IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3與Android Studio Rabbit 2 | 2026.2.2開始，Kotlin Multiplatform（KMP）外掛將停止提供Swift程式碼編輯功能，包括語法上色、檔案導覽，以及在Swift與Kotlin程式碼之間直接跳轉。不過，開發者仍可執行iOS應用程式，也能在iOS裝置上除錯Kotlin程式碼。
